subject: Merchant entity tax forms & VAT reclaim workflow
messages:
From: NSG Supplies Ltd <vendor-portal@nsg.co.uk>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Merchant entity forms + VAT certificate for Redwood PO setup

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Attached are the initial onboarding documents for NSG Supplies (UK branch) so we can get POs and invoicing set up with Redwood:
- NSG_VAT_certificate_UK_2026.pdf (VAT registration certificate)
- PO_Field_Mapping_v2.xlsx (sample invoice / PO fields we typically supply)

To help avoid delays on future invoices, can you confirm:
- Which legal entity at Redwood should we bill (Redwood Inference, Inc. vs Redwood Inference EMEA)?
- Do you need a specific PO field to capture supplier VAT number for automated processing?
- Will Redwood accept gross VAT lines on invoices or do you prefer net amounts with a separate reclaim process?

We can also provide an executed merchant entity declaration if you have a standard form — please share and we’ll return a signed copy.

Thanks,
Eleanor Finch
Vendor Onboarding | NSG Supplies Ltd
vendor-portal@nsg.co.uk

Attachments: NSG_VAT_certificate_UK_2026.pdf, PO_Field_Mapping_v2.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: NSG Supplies Ltd <vendor-portal@nsg.co.uk>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Merchant entity forms + VAT certificate for Redwood PO setup

Thanks Eleanor — received the certificate and the sample mapping. A few quick clarifying items so we can complete our vendor setup and confirm PO behavior:

1) Billing entity: please confirm the exact legal name to print on invoices and the address you intend to use (we have separate AP routing rules for Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) vs Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd).
2) VAT treatment: does NSG expect to charge UK VAT on sales to Redwood (UK-based delivery) or do you intend these invoices to be zero-rated/export under reverse charge? If reverse charge, please confirm the supporting line on each invoice ("reverse charge - Art. 44") and that you will provide the VAT ID used for the supply.
3) PO field: Finance asks that invoices include a discrete field labeled "Supplier VAT ID" and that the VAT amount be a separate monetary line. Can you confirm PO_Field_Mapping_v2.xlsx can be updated to include that column?

I attached our supplier tax declaration template for your legal team to complete — it flags entity name, VAT/GST registration number, fiscal domicile, and whether you will issue VAT invoices. If you can return that plus a signed copy of the VAT certificate, we can progress to creating a PO on our side.

Quick next steps / timeline:
- Eleanor: return filled Supplier_Tax_Declaration.pdf and updated mapping (ETA 48 hours)
- Monica (Finance): once we have docs, will confirm PO entity and whether we should route as gross VAT PO or net (reclaim flow)

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this — helps avoid friction at invoice time.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: Supplier_Tax_Declaration.pdf

From: NSG Supplies Ltd <vendor-portal@nsg.co.uk>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Finch <eleanor@earthline.co.uk>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Merchant entity forms + VAT certificate for Redwood PO setup

Hi Irene / Monica,

Apologies for the short delay — please find the requested items attached:
- Completed_Supplier_Tax_Declaration.pdf (signed by NSG UK CFO)
- NSG_VAT_certificate_UK_2026.pdf (same as before, included for completeness)
- PO_Field_Mapping_v2_updated.xlsx (we added a "Supplier VAT ID" column and separate VAT_amount column)

To confirm the UK position for these shipments/services to Redwood: we will charge UK VAT (standard rated) on invoices to Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd. NSG can issue full VAT invoices. If Redwood intends to reclaim VAT, please note we will need the reclaim reference on the Redwood side — otherwise the VAT will remain charged on the invoice.

Let me know if you prefer us to issue invoices showing VAT separately (recommended) or to provide net-only invoices with a separate reclaim workflow.

Regards,
Eleanor Finch
Vendor Onboarding | NSG Supplies Ltd
vendor-portal@nsg.co.uk

Attachments: Completed_Supplier_Tax_Declaration.pdf, NSG_VAT_certificate_UK_2026.pdf, PO_Field_Mapping_v2_updated.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: NSG Supplies Ltd <vendor-portal@nsg.co.uk>, Eleanor Finch <eleanor@earthline.co.uk>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Merchant entity forms + VAT certificate for Redwood PO setup

Thanks Eleanor, Irene — received the completed declaration and updated mapping. A few final confirmations from Finance to close the loop:

- Preferred invoice format: Redwood will accept invoices that show gross VAT lines (VAT amount separate). Finance will handle reclaiming VAT where eligible; please include a distinct numeric VAT_amount line and the Supplier VAT ID on each invoice.

- Billing entity: please address invoices to "Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd" for EU/UK purchases and include the PO number on the first page of the invoice. We will create POs as gross-value POs (so the invoice should match the PO total including VAT).

- PO field mapping: the attached PO_Field_Mapping_v2_updated.xlsx looks good. For our AP automation we need exact column headers: PO Number | Invoice Date | Invoice Total | VAT Amount | Supplier VAT ID | Invoice Currency. If you can confirm you will preserve those headers in your export, we can turn on automated ingestion.

I will open HS-78921 with Growth Ops (linked above) so we have the ticket for cutover. Expected cutover: once vendor confirms headers and returns a sample invoice (PDF) matching the mapping, we will provision the first PO within 5 business days.

Thanks for the cooperation — quick note on contract terms: since VAT treatment is now settled, we will proceed with standard Redwood payment terms (Net 45) unless AP agrees otherwise.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
